rows: Name the conditions of this match. I will tell you which ones I accept.
Brawling is a term. Set its conditions and I will work within them.
A risk needs conditions too. Tell me yours.
Pace is a condition. I will set it.
The people are entitled to a clear contest with clear terms. That is the condition I set.
I set my terms, and I expect them honoured.
I command a headline on my own terms, and I will not share that decision.
Note the stance. It is the position I have chosen.
You mention technique. Name the conditions for it. Then we can test it.
Strikes are on the agreed list. Nothing else is.
A bet is your condition, not mine. Make it clear.
Stalling is outside the agreed terms. I will not accept it.
The people will be the judge of this contest. Set terms they can see.
You question my independence. Put the question in writing and I will answer it.
Proud of your {strength}, I see, within the conditions. Fine. State its conditions and I will respond to them.
I have noted your {strength}, and I accept it only within the terms we agreed.
You did not flinch. Sensible. That is a condition I can work with.
Point taken. That term is accepted.
I could refuse that outright. I would rather state my terms.
Pinfall, one time. Those are the conditions. Keep me down and the terms are met.
On the mat, the conditions stay the same. Remember them.
Grounded or standing, the terms do not change.
Stay in front of me and answer the conditions in full.
Better answer. It meets the conditions.
You have not answered the question. Answer it under the terms we agreed.
I will allow that. We will test it under the conditions at the bell.
I will wrestle this match within the terms, and I will finish it on those terms.
My approach is direct. I state what I accept, and I stand by it.
Whatever happens, the conditions will be on record.
The result is not yet set. The conditions still hold.
I have one more condition for you. You will hear it when the bell rings.
